name: Layout Builder Limit
description: Provides limits to components in layout builder sections and regions.
project_description:
Layout Builder Limit allows administrators to limit sections and regions to a minimum and maximum amount of components. This allows you require at least 1 block in a region, or limit the maximum amount of blocks in an entire section. 

 When used in tandem with Layout Builder Lock and Layout Builder Restrictions you can completely control which sections are editable, which types of components may be added to sections or regions, and the amount of components allowed or required in a section or region.
